_meta.purpose: Slots whose EMEVD/spawn setup hard-requires the occupant to have an idle/entrance animation. Placing a chr with no idle/entrance anim here breaks the encounter (the spawn setup has no animation state to settle the chr into). The mirror image of nr_no_emerge_slots.json: that file lists slots that REJECT a chr class (emerge_from_ground); this file lists slots that REQUIRE one (anything that is NOT no_intro_anim).
_meta.gate_logic: If (msb, pi) is in this set AND target_cp has V3_ENTRANCE_ANIM_CLASS == 'no_intro_anim', reject the placement. Every other class (emerge_from_ground, fly_in, scripted_intro, pre_placed, walk_in, and the 'unknown' default) passes through. The gate is a negative one: it excludes only the explicitly-classified no-intro chrs, not a positive allowlist — the slot still randomizes widely.

interaction_with_other_systems.V3_PROBLEM_SLOTS: Independent and composes. The Cathedra slot (m38_00 pi=51) is ALSO in V3_PROBLEM_SLOTS (fragile, SAFE_CONFIRMED-only base filter, loosened by V3_PROBLEM_SLOT_EXTRA_ALLOWS for big dragons). That gate addresses a different root cause (cathedral-interior geometry / body size — the v0.20.69 c4620 Astel freeze). This gate addresses the idle/entrance-anim requirement. Both can fire; they are not redundant.
interaction_with_other_systems.V3_PROBLEM_SLOT_EXTRA_BANS: Overlapping but preferred over it for this failure class. A per-slot EXTRA_BANS entry for c5070 would also work, but keying on the V3_ENTRANCE_ANIM_CLASS taxonomy means new no-intro chrs are caught by classifying the chr once, rather than re-listing it per affected slot. Single source of truth, mirrors the V3_NO_EMERGE_SLOTS design.
interaction_with_other_systems.long_term: Stays manual. Like V3_NO_EMERGE_SLOTS this is geometry/EMEVD-dependent, not derivable from chr data. The per-chr side (V3_ENTRANCE_ANIM_CLASS no_intro_anim members) could eventually be populated from a chrbnd/anibnd parser, but the slot list here should not be.

_meta.growth_pattern: Add slots empirically as no-intro-anim CTD/freeze reports surface at new locations. Conservative manual entry — one confirmed slot to start (Cathedra).
